title: MV Yanfly's name box spaced weirdly?

posts.author: Dreamzzz
posts.body:
I'm using the name box feature in
Yanfly's message core
plugin.
I set the padding to 0 in the plugin parameters, and it makes it smaller via width, but not height.
I can't figure out how to get rid of this weird space/padding between the name text. Do I need to tweak the plugin code directly? It doesn't seem like anything in the parameters would be able to fix this.
How do I get the name box to be sized the same way as the square I drew in yellow?
Or alternatively, how do I get it to not use a window skin at all? and just be large text with an outline?
Thanks in advance for the help! :')

posts.author: ShadowDragon
posts.body:
padding = X, if you want to target the height, its mostly "this.lineHeight()".
I don'know what the padding does normally, but * 0 wouldn't do much
so it should be 1 or remove * 0 entirely.
while standard padding is 18 I believe, try fixed number like 12 and see what happens.
